blocks.text: HANGS Construction Services LLC
FY2026 corporate tax questionnaire
Demonstration document. Not for filing or payment.
Tax year: FY2026
Answered by: Dana Whitfield, Controller
Answered on: 2026-10-23

rows: Accrual. Contract revenue by the percentage-of-completion method for books and tax, as in prior years.
Fiscal year ending June 30. This return is for July 1, 2025 to June 30, 2026.
Celeste Whitford 60% and Riley Tanaka 40%, both U.S. individuals. No change in the year.

President and CEO Celeste Whitford: salary $395,000.00. Chief Financial Officer Jordan Hale: salary $310,000.00. Vice President Riley Tanaka is not an employee and was paid nothing. The board resolution approving FY2026 officer pay was prepared and has not been signed.
Related companies and transactions with owners

Juniper Ridge Partners LLC is owned by our Vice President. We are building its business park (job J-2625) under a cost-plus contract; pay application 1, $277,875.00, was billed June 30, 2026 and paid July 20, 2026. No loans to or from shareholders.
Fines or penalties paid to a government
Yes. A $6,800.00 Labor and Industries citation penalty (fall protection, Alder Point Medical Pavilion), in account 6500.
Business meals on the corporate card, $41,860.00, and arena suite tickets for owners’ representatives, $6,400.00, with no meal. Both in account 6500.
Two cash gifts to section 501(c)(3) organizations, $5,000.00 in all, each acknowledged in writing. No carryover from FY2025.

Seven additions. The 30-ton excavator (EQ-4410) was ordered under a purchase contract signed December 2, 2024 and delivered August 14, 2025. The 2005 crawler crane (EQ-2740) was sold March 16, 2026 for $180,000.00; the proceeds were credited to accumulated depreciation. Two 2008 office trailers were scrapped. No election out of the special allowance and no section 179 election.

No FY2026 estimated payments were made: the board deferred them while the line of credit was drawn, expecting the FY2025 loss to cover the year. Form 7004 was filed September 15, 2026 with a $15,000.00 payment.
Four quarterly dividends of $90,000.00 declared by the board and paid September 30 and December 31, 2025 and March 31 and June 30, 2026; 60% and 40%. Forms 1099-DIV issued for each calendar year.
FY2025 ended with a $2,904,180.00 net operating loss on the return as filed, carried forward.

The warranty reserve on completed jobs was $118,000.00 at June 30, 2025 and $125,000.00 at June 30, 2026; warranty work is charged to other job costs (5500) when done. The other June 30 accruals were paid by mid-September.

preview.subject: HANGS Construction Services 2025 Form 1120 (FY2026) year-end records
preview.body:
Hi,

Attached are the audited trial balance at June 30, 2026, the ledger detail you asked for and the equipment register with book and tax depreciation. Last year's return summary, the questionnaire, the tax payment log and the board resolution are in the shared folder. Please prepare the 2025 Form 1120 for our fiscal year ended June 30, 2026 for us to review. We filed Form 7004 on September 15 with a $15,000.00 payment.

A few things you will want to look at:

- We made no estimated payments during FY2026; the board expected last year's loss to cover the year.
- The depreciation software took 100% bonus on every FY2026 addition.
- The board resolution for officer pay still has to be signed.
- The crane we sold in March went through accumulated depreciation, not a gain account.
- Juniper Ridge paid pay application 1 on July 20.

Thanks,
Dana Whitfield
Controller, HANGS Construction Services LLC

messages.subject: HANGS Construction Services 2025 Form 1120 (FY2026) year-end records
messages.body:
Hi,

Attached are the audited trial balance at June 30, 2026, the ledger detail you asked for and the equipment register with book and tax depreciation. Last year's return summary, the questionnaire, the tax payment log and the board resolution are in the shared folder. Please prepare the 2025 Form 1120 for our fiscal year ended June 30, 2026 for us to review. We filed Form 7004 on September 15 with a $15,000.00 payment.

A few things you will want to look at:

- We made no estimated payments during FY2026; the board expected last year's loss to cover the year.
- The depreciation software took 100% bonus on every FY2026 addition.
- The board resolution for officer pay still has to be signed.
- The crane we sold in March went through accumulated depreciation, not a gain account.
- Juniper Ridge paid pay application 1 on July 20.

Thanks,
Dana Whitfield
Controller, HANGS Construction Services LLC

sources.title: Form 1120 (2025), U.S. Corporation Income Tax Return

passages.q: Which 2025 Form 1120 lines does the draft fill?
passages.a: 31 Total tax (Schedule J, line 12) ... 33 Total payments, credits, and section 1062 applicable net tax liability (Schedule J, line 23) ... 34 Estimated tax penalty. See instructions. Check if Form 2220 is attached ... Schedule M-1 ... 5 Expenses recorded on books this year not deducted on this return (itemize): a Depreciation ... b Charitable contributions ... c Travel and entertainment ... 8 Deductions on this return not charged against book income this year (itemize): a Depreciation

sources.title: Instructions for Form 1120 (2025), U.S. Corporation Income Tax Return

passages.q: What is the 2025 corporate income tax rate?
passages.a: Line 1a. Income tax. Multiply taxable income (page 1, line 30) by 21% (0.21). Enter this amount on line 1a.

passages.q: When is the return for a fiscal year ending June 30, 2026 due?
passages.a: Generally, a corporation must file its income tax return by the 15th day of the 4th month after the end of its tax year ... However, a corporation with a fiscal tax year ending June 30 must file by the 15th day of the 3rd month after the end of its tax year.

passages.q: Must HANGS complete Schedules L, M-1 and M-2, and is Schedule M-3 needed instead?
passages.a: Corporations with total receipts (page 1, line 1a plus lines 4 through 10) and total assets at the end of the tax year less than $250,000 are not required to complete Schedules L, M-1, and M-2 ... Corporations with total assets nonconsolidated ... of $10 million or more on the last day of the tax year must file Schedule M-3 (Form 1120) instead of Schedule M-1.

sources.title: Instructions for Form 2220 (2025), Underpayment of Estimated Tax by Corporations

passages.q: What did HANGS have to pay in each 2025 installment?
passages.a: Generally, a corporation is subject to the penalty if it did not timely pay at least the smaller of: the tax shown on its 2025 return, or the tax shown on its 2024 return (if it filed a 2024 return showing at least some amount of tax and the return was for a full 12 months). ... A large corporation is a corporation ... that had ... taxable income ... of $1 million or more for any of the 3 tax years immediately preceding the 2025 tax year ... The corporation is generally required to enter the 15th day of the 4th ... 6th, 9th, and 12th months of its tax year.

passages.q: How is the penalty for the short September installment figured?
passages.a: The period of underpayment generally runs from the installment due date to the earlier of the date the underpayment is actually paid or the 15th day of the 4th month after the close of the tax year. ... A payment of estimated tax is applied against unpaid required installments in the order in which installments are required to be paid, regardless of the installment to which the payment pertains.

sources.title: Instructions for Form 4562 (2025), Depreciation and Amortization

passages.q: What special depreciation allowance applies to the excavator, the crew 3 truck and the tablets acquired in 2025?
passages.a: P.L. 119-21, commonly known as the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, reinstated the 100% special depreciation allowance for certain qualified property acquired and placed in service after January 19, 2025 ... However, you can elect to take a 40% special depreciation allowance ... during first tax year ending after January 19, 2025, instead of taking the 100% special depreciation allowance.

sources.title: Instructions for Form 4797 (2025), Sales of Business Property

passages.q: How is the crane sale taxed when the books recorded no gain?
passages.a: Section 1245 property is property that is depreciable ... and is one of the following. Personal property.

passages.q: How long does Form 7004 extend a June 30 corporation?
passages.a: C corporations with tax years ending June 30 and beginning before January 1, 2026, are eligible for an automatic 7-month extension of time to file ... For tax years beginning in 2026, the automatic extension period is 6 months.

sources.title: Instructions for Form 8990 (12/2025), Limitation on Business Interest Expense

passages.a: For tax years beginning in 2025, a taxpayer meets the gross receipts test if the taxpayer has average annual gross receipts of $31 million or less for the 3 prior tax years ... P.L. 119-21 ... amended section 163(j) to allow an add-back to taxable income for any deduction allowable for depreciation, amortization, or depletion to determine ATI for tax years beginning after 2024.

passages.q: Can the warranty reserve be deducted when it is booked?
passages.a: Other liabilities for which economic performance occurs as you make payments include liabilities for breach of contract ..., violation of law, rebates and refunds, awards, prizes, jackpots, insurance, and warranty and service contracts.

passages.q: What allowance applies to the trailer ordered in December 2024 and delivered in January 2025?
passages.a: Unless you elect out, you must take a 40% special depreciation allowance for certain qualified property acquired after September 27, 2017, and placed in service after December 31, 2024, and before January 1, 2026 (other than certain property with a long production period and certain aircraft).

passages.q: What recovery period and rates apply to the construction equipment, vehicles and computers?
passages.a: 5-year property. Automobiles, taxis, buses, helicopters, and trucks. ... Construction: Includes assets used in construction by general building, special trade, heavy, and marine construction contractors ... Table A-1. 3-, 5-, 7-, 10-, 15-, and 20-year property, half-year convention ... 5-year: 20.00% 32.00 19.20 11.52 11.52 5.76

passages.q: What underpayment rate applies to each part of the penalty period?
passages.a: 2026 interest rates by category ... Underpayment (corporate and non-corporate) 7% 7% 6% 7% (4th, 3rd, 2nd and 1st quarters).

sources.title: 26 U.S. Code 482, Allocation of income and deductions among taxpayers

passages.q: Does the job for the Vice President's company have to be at arm's length?
passages.a: In any case of two or more organizations, trades, or businesses (whether or not incorporated, whether or not organized in the United States, and whether or not affiliated) owned or controlled directly or indirectly by the same interests, the Secretary may distribute, apportion, or allocate gross income, deductions, credits, or allowances between or among such organizations, trades, or businesses ...
